items.question: What is the initial investment required?
items.answer: Investment packages are custom-tailored to your desired format (Mobile Vintage Cart, Mall Kiosk, or Flagship Storefront), including commercial cold-press equipment, starter inventory, and complete training.

items.question: How does the sugarcane stalk supply chain work?
items.answer: We manage centralized agricultural imports and dispatch fresh, temperature-controlled, mature organic sugarcane stalks directly to your local operating hub on a weekly schedule.

items.question: Do I need prior food & beverage experience?
items.answer: No prior hospitality experience is necessary. Our intensive 2-week training program covers machine operation, hygiene standards, recipe mastery, inventory control, and customer service.

items.question: Are exclusive territory rights available?
items.answer: Yes, franchise partners receive protected geographic territory rights based on agreed postcode clusters and population demographics.
